page.notes: The first letters of the first line are partly cut off at the left edge of the column, so "nis" is doubtful. The Greek word in the line "nos amet ... adhor" could not be read letter by letter and is marked illegible. The running head is set in small capitals and read as "Iocosis.". The page number is read as 367 from a partly faded print.
